grading_resources.note: Independent grading needs enough compile capacity to honor unchanged official test timeouts; both arms use identical settings.

source: Desktop retrac-handoff.zip independent paper implementation; not author-official code
interface_note: Academy Docker instead of Cube; pinned official TmuxSession + handed-off TmuxTerminal. Fresh task container/HOME, persistent shell across eight rollouts. No shared memory across tasks.
differences: Physical host/CPU and Docker PID/proc namespace differ from Cube.
Per-process AS3GiB is matched; no Cube16GB aggregate parent-container cap.
48k UTF8 JSON messages; RE-TRAC has no function schemas. Historical DH counted characters, DSH includes schemas.
Native nonblocking tmux duration caps waiting, not subprocess lifetime; entire sandbox is stopped at task end/deadline.
budget_adapter: Byte-aware observation/size plus bounded compression specification replacing exhaustive prose, and small-JSON output instruction. Original engine/client/prompts source files stay sealed; 8x50/full recursive algorithm and original two format attempts unchanged. 800/600/4096/48000 budgets unchanged; no silent state truncation.
grading: One immutable final source artifact, unchanged official grader, no online hidden feedback
workspace_transport: Fresh no-copy app volume; pinned public source tar owns uid/gid0; nested write preflight before any paid request. No added sandbox capabilities.
